card.name: The word accept and its forms
card.fires_on: The word accept in any form (accept, accepted, acceptance, acceptable), including when split after a prefix like Test or Publication. It appears in dictionary entries, polite requests and acceptance criteria.

modes.label: Accept as a verb
modes.description: Accept or accepted used as a verb meaning to agree to or receive something.

modes.label: Accepted as an adjective
modes.description: Accepted meaning widely agreed or approved.
modes.example: Dr. Robert J. Morgan Today, it is generally<< accepted>> that work is necessary to earn an income

modes.label: Acceptance after another word
modes.description: The accept- part of acceptance or acceptable that follows a preceding word or word part.
modes.example: Table 1. Specifications of Gallium Ga 68 Gozetotide Injection Test<< Accept>>ance criteria Method Appearance Clear, colorless
